title: Deal Math Market Brief (Deal Math)
description: Sourced real estate news for investors from realestate.samcbarth.com.

items.title: 30-year mortgage rate eases to 7.18%, third weekly decline
items.summary: Freddie Mac's weekly survey put the average 30-year fixed rate at 7.18% on November 5, down from 7.24% a week earlier but up from 6.22% a year ago.
items.content_text: Freddie Mac's weekly survey put the average 30-year fixed rate at 7.18% on November 5, down from 7.24% a week earlier but up from 6.22% a year ago.

items.title: Oklahoma voters reject SQ 847, keeping the 3% and 5% property value caps
items.summary: State Question 847, which would have cut Oklahoma's yearly cap on taxable value growth from 3% to 1.75% for homesteads and ag land and from 5% to 4% for other property, failed on November 3.
items.content_text: State Question 847, which would have cut Oklahoma's yearly cap on taxable value growth from 3% to 1.75% for homesteads and ag land and from 5% to 4% for other property, failed on November 3.

items.title: Fed holds its target range at 3.75% to 4%, with two votes for a hike
items.summary: The Federal Open Market Committee left the federal funds target range at 3-3/4 to 4 percent on October 28; Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack dissented in favor of a quarter-point increase.
items.content_text: The Federal Open Market Committee left the federal funds target range at 3-3/4 to 4 percent on October 28; Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack dissented in favor of a quarter-point increase.

items.title: Texas home sales fell 4.7% from a year earlier in August as inventory stayed high
items.summary: The Texas Real Estate Research Center reported 28,740 closed sales in August, down 4.7% year over year, a $330,000 median price and 5.3 months of inventory.
items.content_text: The Texas Real Estate Research Center reported 28,740 closed sales in August, down 4.7% year over year, a $330,000 median price and 5.3 months of inventory.

items.title: U.S. housing starts fell 5.2% in September to a 1.22 million pace
items.summary: Census Bureau data showed September housing starts at a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1,221,000, down 5.2% from August and 7.4% from a year earlier; permits were 1,400,000.
items.content_text: Census Bureau data showed September housing starts at a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1,221,000, down 5.2% from August and 7.4% from a year earlier; permits were 1,400,000.

items.title: Existing-home sales rose 1.5% in September; median price $417,500
items.summary: NAR reported existing-home sales at a 3.99 million annual rate in September, up 1.5% from August and down 2.2% from a year earlier, with a 4.8-month supply.
